pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 38

6. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 36

9. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 8

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

12. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 11
   C. 100
   D. 10

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 33
   D. 28

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

18. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

21. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 14
   C. 10
   D. 2

25. Solve for x: x + 5 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 12

26. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

27. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 17

28. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

29. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 18

30. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
